name: shotcut-mcp
description: Full transactional editor for Shotcut projects through a local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Edit complete Shotcut timelines with transactional safety.
interface.longDescription: Local Shotcut and MLT integration for source-quality analysis, stable-reference multitrack editing, visual review, permission-first export, durable progress, backups, and delivery of rendered media with the exact editable project.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this Shotcut project is ready, explain missing media or services, and analyze its sources for quality issues.
Inspect these media files, build or revise the Shotcut timeline I describe, and show a visual review of the result.
Review and approve an export, monitor its render, and deliver both media and the exact editable project.
